## Step 3: Final Balance Calculation  
### Balance Calculation Process  
**Step 1: Collect All Transactions**
- Pull all transactions since last statement
- Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)
- Verify no unprocessed deposits/withdrawals  
**Step 2: Calculate Final Balance**
- Ledger balance (posted transactions)
- Add any pending interest (if accrual period not yet completed)
- Subtract any pending fees (overdraft, if applicable)
- Verify balance matches account record in AMS  
**Step 3: Document Balance**
- Print final statement
- Include calculation date
- List all pending transactions
- Final balance clearly stated  
**Step 4: Approval**
- Operations manager verifies calculation
- Sign-off on final statement
- File in account closure record

raw_entities.name: Balance Calculation Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for calculating and documenting a customer account's final balance prior to closure. The process collects all transactions since the last statement, computes the final balance including pending interest and fees, generates a final statement, and obtains operations manager approval and sign-off.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Verify balance matches account record in AMS

raw_entities.name: Collect All Transactions
raw_entities.description: Initial step to gather all financial transactions affecting the account since the last statement, including both posted and pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due), with verification that no deposits or withdrawals remain unprocessed.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

raw_entities.name: Calculate Final Balance
raw_entities.description: Computation step that determines the account's final balance by combining the ledger balance of posted transactions, adding any accrued but unpaid interest, subtracting pending fees and overdraft charges, and cross-verifying the result against the Account Management System (AMS) record.
context: Add any pending interest (if accrual period not yet completed)
Subtract any pending fees (overdraft, if applicable)
Verify balance matches account record in AMS

raw_entities.name: Document Balance
raw_entities.description: Step to formally record and communicate the final balance by printing a final statement that includes the calculation date, itemizes all pending transactions, and clearly displays the final balance figure.

raw_entities.name: Approval of Final Statement
raw_entities.description: Final authorization step in which the operations manager reviews and verifies the balance calculation, provides formal sign-off on the final statement, and ensures the document is filed in the account closure record.

raw_entities.name: Operations Manager
raw_entities.description: Senior operations staff member responsible for verifying the accuracy of the final balance calculation, authorizing the final statement, and ensuring proper filing of closure documentation.

raw_entities.name: Posted Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that has been fully processed and settled on the account ledger, forming the basis of the ledger balance used in final balance calculation.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement

raw_entities.name: Pending Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that has been initiated but not yet fully processed or settled, including standing orders and direct debits due, which must be included in the final balance calculation.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: A recurring payment instruction on the account that may be pending at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit
raw_entities.description: A direct debit mandate on the account that may be due at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: The customer account undergoing closure, for which a final balance calculation is performed. The account record is maintained in the Account Management System (AMS) and serves as the verification source for the calculated balance.
context: Verify balance matches account record in AMS

raw_entities.name: Account Management System
raw_entities.description: The automated system that maintains the authoritative account record and serves as the verification source for confirming that the manually calculated final balance matches the system-held account balance.
context: Verify balance matches account record in AMS
